boundary: The 418-gate circuit is exact and improves the prior 512-gate candidate. Global gate-count or depth optimality is not claimed.

lower_bounds.proof: Full 36-mode support requires depth at least ceil(log2 36)=6 and a connected interaction graph with at least 35 edges.

parameterization: c=sign_c*sqrt(c2), s=sign_s*sqrt(s2), with exact rational c2+s2=1
terminal_phase: one pi sign on the final mode
